ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity yellowish-white background covering approximately 88% of the surface area, contrasted with low-intensity black pigmentation covering approximately 12% concentrated on edges and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary light-intensity central lobes; dense low-intensity black bands along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; vertical dark pixel cluster extending inferiorly from the median notch; scattered low-intensity focal points and short linear segments across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees; depth is significant, extending roughly 1/6th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (3-15 pixels); peaks are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, transitioning to a smoother but still jagged topography near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward, terminating in sharp convex-recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small circular pixel clusters (white on black at margins, dark on white in center lobes) consistent with sessile organism attachment sites, primarily localized on the distal tips and upper trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct, near-parallel vertical dark lines (rake marks) on the mid-right lobe; several smaller, unaligned linear disruptions on the lower-left and lower-right quadrants.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks on the right lobe and irregular pigmentation scars; jagged indentation on the upper left lobe tip suggesting minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'Y' shaped dark pigment mark on the outer right lobe and a vertical dark streak extending from the apex of the median notch.
